# 3D Motion Sports

> > Athletic motion analysis services using 3D biomechanics and the zenoLINK system to prevent injuries and optimize performance in baseball, golf, and other sports.

3D Motion Sports specializes in biomechanical analysis for athletes, particularly focusing on pitching mechanics and golf swing analysis. Founded by Chris Welch using Welch-e Technologies' zenoLINK system, the company emphasizes injury prevention in youth sports through data-driven motion analysis rather than subjective coaching opinions.

## Key Topics

- 3D biomechanical analysis
- zenoLINK motion capture system
- Pitching mechanics and analysis
- Golf swing biomechanics
- Youth sports injury prevention
- Kinetic chain analysis
- Baseball biomechanics
- Sports performance optimization
- Overuse injury prevention
- Rotational movement analysis
- Chris Welch
- Progressive Skills Training
- Motion capture calibration
- Muscular loading patterns
- Student athlete safety

## About 3D Motion Sports

- [3D Motion Sports | The Analysis of Human Athletic Motion – Moving From Opinion to Fact](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com): Homepage for athletic motion analysis services using biomechanical data
- [About | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/about): About page describing 3D imaging technology for personalized athlete training
- [What We Do! | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2012/08/20/what-we-do): Explains 3D Motion Sports' biomechanics analysis and injury prevention services
- [Why 3D Biomechanical Analysis? | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/01/31/6): ZenoLink technology benefits for diagnosing athlete movement weaknesses

## Pitching Analysis & Baseball Biomechanics

- [3D Pitching Analysis-Kinetic Link/Chain | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/05/09/3d-pitching-analysis-kinetic-linkchain): ZenoLINK system kinetic chain analysis for pitching like 4-stage rocket
- [3D Pitching Analysis-Muscular Loading | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/06/24/3d-pitching-analysis-muscular-loading): Explains muscular loading and stretch-shorten effect in pitching mechanics
- [3D Pitching Analysis-Calibration | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/04/11/3d-pitching-analysis-calibration): ZenoLINK calibration cube setup and multi-camera filming process explained
- [A 3D Biomechanical Pitching Analysis | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/04/04/a-3d-biomechanical-pitching-analysis): Youth baseball injuries discussed at AOSSM conference in New Orleans
- [Rays vs Sox | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2011/09/16/137): Shields vs Beckett pitching mechanics comparison for Tampa Bay-Boston game

## Golf Swing Analysis

- [Golf Swing Analysis-Report of Findings | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2012/08/27/golf-swing-analysis-report-of-findings): Sample client report showing golf swing analysis findings and methodology
- [Golf Biomechanics 101 | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/golf-biomechanics-101): Chris Welch video on golf swing biomechanics and 3D analysis importance
- [zenoLINK Golf Swing Analysis | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/03/27/zenolink-golf-swing-analysis): ZenoLINK system features for golf swing analysis and injury detection

## Youth Sports Injury Prevention

- [How Can We Protect Our Young Athletes? | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/02/18/how-can-we-protect-our-young-athletes): Book review of Mark Hyman's 'Until It Hurts' on youth sports injuries
- [Youth Sports | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/05/24/youth-sports): Daily youth athlete injury statistics linked to faulty biomechanics
- [Student Athletes | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/04/19/student-athletes): Youth sports injury statistics and Stop Sports Injuries campaign pledge
- [Stop Sports Injuries Campaign | 3D Motion Sports](https://3dmotionsports.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/stop-sports-injuries-campaign): Bradford, Smoltz, and Dr. Andrews discuss youth injuries on Fox News
